correctness.rationale: Norrbo establishes boundedness of H:A^2_log²→A² and failure to map the full space below alpha=2. For alpha>2, orthogonality of monomials gives inclusion singular values (omega_n,2/omega_n,alpha)^1/2∼(log n)^(1-alpha/2)→0; thus the inclusion into A²_log² is compact, and composition with the bounded endpoint H is compact. At alpha=2, explicit blocks f_N=(log N)^(-3/2) Σ_{n=N}^{N²}z^n have uniformly bounded nonzero A²_log² norms and are weakly null; for N≤m≤N^(3/2), summing n from N^(3/2) to N² produces H-image coefficients≥c/(log N)^1/2. Sum of output Bergman weights 1/(m+1) over that block∼(1/2)log N, so output norm stays bounded away from 0. Independent arithmetic block checks at N=32,64,128 reproduce trend; analytic harmonic sums, not these finite values, prove noncompactness. The three cases cover real alpha, with no statement on exact full norm or essential norm.
